subject: Mental Models
title: Asymmetric Warfare
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Asymmetric Warfare.

hook.text: David faced Goliath not with a sword but a sling.

buildup.text: Asymmetric strategy means a weaker player avoids the stronger player's advantages and competes on different dimensions.

discovery.text: Ivan Arreguin-Toft found that weak combatants who use asymmetric strategies win 63% of conflicts.

twist.text: The strong player's greatest vulnerability is their investment in the current rules.

climax.text: Never compete where the leader is strongest. Find the dimension they ignore and attack there.

punchline.text: Do not fight on their terms. Change the game.

quiz.question: What did Arreguin-Toft find about asymmetric strategies?
options: They always fail against stronger opponents
Weaker players win 63% when using them
They only work in military contexts
